d: King Charles swapped royal formalities for dancing in the streets of Nassau! On the second day of his Caribbean tour, the King joined revellers at the Bahamas’ colourful Junkanoo parade, waving instruments and moving along with performers in elaborate costumes. The festival celebrates Bahamian culture, but the royal visit comes amid increasingly vocal calls across the Caribbean for Britain to pay reparations for its role in the transatlantic slave trade.
